milestones.title: Find animals by more names
milestones.description: We built a better species directory that understands scientific names, common names, and other known names. It's designed to keep saved species connected when the directory is updated.
milestones.benefit: Finding the right animal should be easier as we add more species data.

milestones.title: Making room for more kinds of pets
milestones.description: Care Keeper's animal tracking is being prepared for more than snakes, lizards, spiders, and scorpions. Your current animals and their histories keep working as before.
milestones.benefit: Dogs, fish, birds, frogs, and others can be added in future updates; they are not available to add yet.

milestones.title: Helpful care guides, with sources
milestones.description: Species pages gained clearer care information and a quick overview. When a guide is available, you can check its source instead of guessing where the advice came from.
milestones.benefit: Understand the available guidance and where it came from, without wading through long documents.

milestones.title: More dependable care history
milestones.description: We improved how saved records are read when different actions happen close together, and prepared Care Keeper for new animal types without losing older records.
milestones.benefit: Fewer confusing errors when records change at the same time.

milestones.title: Better tools for support
milestones.description: Trusted operators gained a way to review account and system problems without changing a keeper's records.
milestones.benefit: When something goes wrong, support can understand the problem without altering your animal history.

milestones.title: A cleaner view of your care history
milestones.description: Routine technical entries are no longer mixed into the care history that you see for your animals.
milestones.benefit: Find feeding, cleaning, and other care records without unrelated background entries getting in the way.

milestones.title: Search for animals and plants
milestones.description: We added a species and plant directory, with suggestions when you type a name and the option to enter an animal manually if you can't find it.
milestones.benefit: Adding an animal can start with a name you know, even when a species isn't listed.

milestones.title: Know what supplies you have and what they cost
milestones.description: Inventory gained food and supply tracking, purchase history, stock counts, and reports to help you see what you're using and spending.
milestones.benefit: See when you're running low, keep counts accurate, and understand the cost of caring for your animals.

milestones.title: Fix a care entry you made by mistake
milestones.description: We added a way to remove an incorrect care record from the normal view while keeping its change history safe.
milestones.benefit: Correct mistakes without losing the story of what happened.

milestones.title: A fresh Care Keeper for phone and desktop
milestones.description: The application gained its current look, Today and Calendar views, Quick Log, easier navigation, charts, reports, and account tools.
milestones.benefit: Check what needs doing, record care quickly, and review your animals from a phone or computer.

milestones.title: Spiders join the collection
milestones.description: Spiders gained their own care needs, including molting and premolt records, while sharing useful features such as feeding, photos, and reminders.
milestones.benefit: Keep track of a spider's care without pretending it needs exactly the same records as a snake.

milestones.title: Reminders, supplies, and expenses
milestones.description: Care Keeper gained care schedules, a list of what's due today or later, basic supplies, and expense tracking.
milestones.benefit: Keep important tasks together and get a clearer view of your care routine.

milestones.title: Animal profiles, photos, and enclosures
milestones.description: The first animal pages brought together feeding and care notes, measurements, enclosure changes, photos, and corrections.
milestones.benefit: See an animal's story in one place and keep its care records organized.

milestones.title: Saving changes more reliably
milestones.description: We built the record-keeping foundation that helps Care Keeper keep history straight when details are corrected or updated.
milestones.benefit: Your existing care information has a more dependable history behind it.

milestones.title: Personal accounts and households
milestones.description: Care Keeper gained sign-in, account setup, and private household spaces.
milestones.benefit: Your collection can be kept separate from someone else's.

milestones.title: The beginning of Care Keeper
milestones.description: We created the basic application, its local database, and the tools needed to build the animal-care features that followed.
milestones.benefit: The foundation for everything else in Care Keeper.
